title: Chapter 211 The Beauty Of Winter
content:
Chapter 211 The Beauty Of Winter

The rampant voice of the Black Dragon King reverberated over the altar wantonly, making Wang Shuo shudder.

Wang Shuo was a little puzzled. Didn't he just hear the system prompt that he had killed the Black Dragon King?

What was going on with this unscrupulous voice?

The soldiers around him also looked at the sky vigilantly, but there was nothing except the thick death and the ethereal echo!

Obviously, this "Black Dragon King" did not answer his doubts, and even ignored him. After releasing the pent-up energy in his heart for thousands of years, he disappeared into the sky.

Wang Shuo felt a little strange. Why was he in a hurry to escape?

At this moment, in a palace across tens of thousands of miles, Queen Anna felt something in her heart and was furious.

The staff inlaid with a huge gem in her hand was directly crushed by her.

The colorful light emanated from her body, changing constantly with her face.

"Who dared to kill that unforgivable man and rescue his soul?" Her angry roar directly knocked the maids around her to the wall, spitting blood.

Wang Shuo naturally could not feel Queen Anna's anger.

Ye Xueer came over and said softly to Wang Shuo: "My copy mission has been completed."

"Uh."

Wang Shuo was a little disappointed. He wanted to ask for her to stay, but he didn't know what reason to use.

There was a silence for a while.

Ye Xueer bit her lips lightly, held the thumb with four fingers on her left hand and rubbed it gently, and pulled the corner of her clothes with her right hand, as if waiting for Wang Shuo to say something.

However, Wang Shuo was like a piece of wood, at a loss!

After waiting for a long time, she showed a faint disappointment on her face, and suddenly, she smiled again on her pretty face, and said: "Then, I'm leaving!"

She slowly took out a scroll, and with a thought, a portal appeared not far away.

Ye Xueer walked slowly, each step was very slow, but each step was moving away from Wang Shuo.

Looking at the back figure going away, all kinds of thoughts came to Wang Shuo's mind. He stretched out his right hand and moved his lips, but he couldn't make a sound.

Suddenly, she turned around and saw Wang Shuo's hand stiff in the air, and laughed out loud.

Her smile was like a flower!

Wang Shuo couldn't help but feel excited!

"I'm from the Sky City!"

After saying that, she turned around, stepped into the portal, and disappeared, as if she had never appeared.

Wang Shuo felt lost!

After a while, he slapped his forehead and exclaimed: "Fuck, I actually forgot to add a friend!"

After a while, Wang Shuo felt like a dream!

He couldn't help but think of when he was a child, he went to his grandmother's house during the Chinese New Year.

A beautiful little girl also came to his grandmother's neighbor's house, with two pigtails and a bright red coat.

The round little face looks like a red apple.

They played snowball fights and made snowmen together, and let the big black dog pull the car made by grandpa and run around everywhere.

They doodled on the snow together, drew the stick drawings taught by the teacher, and wrote their own names!

They played house together...

These few short days were the most unforgettable fun in Wang Shuo's childhood!

So much so that the next year, Wang Shuo prepared a gift for the little girl a few days before going to his grandmother's house.

But when he arrived at his grandmother's house, he did not see the little girl in a red cotton jacket and pigtails.

Later, every year when he went to his grandmother's house, he wanted to see the girl again, but he never saw her again.

Although this past event buried deep in Wang Shuo's heart brought some regrets, it became a beautiful memory in his heart.
